title: Columbia internal citation Sankey — classified cross-field only
description: 2021–2024 Columbia OpenAlex snapshot, all work types. Distinct directed work-ID citation pairs with both endpoints in works; identical work-ID self-loops excluded (none); shared-author citations retained. Assign each work to the field of its primary topic, using assigned topic only if primary information is unavailable (primary flag, score descending, rank ascending, topic ID ascending); otherwise UNCLASSIFIED. Same/cross require two classified endpoints. One node per field × endpoint role shown; one weighted edge per displayed ordered field pair. Top 25 by descending citation count then ascending citing/cited field IDs, showing 4,490 of 10,264 eligible citations and 25 of 374 eligible links. Left citing → right cited.
